file_metadata.description: Rules engine for Matins: Hymn Stacking, Canon Insertions, Lookahead, Bridegroom Canon, Psalm 50 Intercession, and Passion Gospel Formula.
file_metadata.authority: Lviv (Dolnytsky) Typikon (2010) Part I, III, IV

sidalen_1.note: Sunday + Polyeleos Saint: Stack Resurrectional and Saint Sidalens

after_6th.note: Polyeleos/Vigil: Feast/Season Kontakion moves to Ode 6

rules.note: Saturday Matins with Polyeleos: 'Both Now' is NOT from Menaion, but next Sunday's Tone.

bridegroom_canon_type.description: Determines whether Bridegroom Matins canon is a full triodion or a diodion (two-ode), based on the day of Holy Week.

rules.note: Holy Monday: full triodion canon from the Holy Week Triodion proper.
Holy Tuesday: diodion — only Odes 8 and 9. This is the distinguishing rubric for Tuesday (Dolnytsky IV:561).
Holy Wednesday: full triodion canon from the Holy Week Triodion proper.

psalm_50_intercession.description: Determines the intercession verse sung at Glory after Psalm 50 at Lenten Matins.

rules.note: Polyeleos or Vigil saint: 'Glory: Through the prayers of N., O Merciful One, blot out the multitude of my transgressions.'
Default (no Polyeleos): 'Glory: Through the prayers of the Holy Apostles, O Merciful One, blot out the multitude of my transgressions.'

passion_gospel_formula.description: Replaces standard Gospel acclamations with Passion-specific texts for all 12 Passion Gospels.

before_gospel.standard: Glory to Thee, O Lord, glory to Thee.
before_gospel.passion_replacement: Glory to Thy Passion, O Lord, glory to Thee.

after_gospel.standard: Glory to Thee, O Lord, glory to Thee.
after_gospel.passion_replacement: Glory to Thy long-suffering, O Lord, glory to Thee.

passion_gospel_formula.special_note: After the 12th Gospel, bells cease and only wooden clappers are used until the Resurrection (Dolnytsky IV:653).

tomb_matins_encomia_stations.description: Divides Psalm 118 (Kathisma 17) into three stations with Encomia stichera interspersed.

stations.note: Third Stasis — Encomia III, with Theotokion and Trisagion at end
